initialize_guardrail: initialize a guardrail from a dictionary and add it to the litellm callback manager
reinitialize_guardrail: force re-initialization of an existing guardrail by removing old callback and creating a fresh instance
sync_guardrail_from_db: sync a guardrail from database by initializing if new or re-initializing if parameters have changed
delete_in_memory_guardrail: delete a guardrail from memory and remove its callback from litellm callbacks
add_guardrail_to_db: add a guardrail entry to the database with serialized litellm params and guardrail info
